correctness.rationale: The three-gap argument proves both a global lower bound and equality rigidity using only two-by-two principal Gram eigenvalues and strict monotonicity. The candidate triple has offdiagonal correlations p,p,-p and exact eigenvalues k+p,k+p,k-2p. The Fourier reproducing kernel is strictly decreasing by a positive sine-series Laplace integral for every real s>1/2; a closed modulo-six identity gives the sign assumption. Uniform Dirichlet convergence gives the critical log kernel, while a first-harmonic/mean-value expansion yields the 1/(3π√3) displacement and 2/3 relative gain coefficients. The included standard-library checker passed 1,466 finite checks, not used for infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: Exact best three-sensor simultaneous output-energy control for the whole natural mean-zero periodic fractional Sobolev scale, including all noninteger orders. A simple general kernel criterion and equality classification apply beyond this space. Nonuniformity survives every admissible exponent and has a quantified exponentially small gain at very high smoothness, supplying a mathematically motivated complete classification and asymptotic design law rather than an arbitrary isolated invariant.
